notes_list.title: Integrated Spectral Structure Elucidation
notes_list.basic_overview: A reliable structure-elucidation workflow combines molecular formula/DBE with IR, UV, 1H NMR, 13C NMR and reaction clues rather than relying on a single spectrum.
notes_list.extra_info_content: Start with formula and DBE, identify functional groups from IR, use NMR signal count/integration/multiplicity/coupling to build fragments, then verify the complete structure.
notes_list.examples: Unknown with one carbonyl, ethyl group and aromatic signals can be narrowed by combining IR carbonyl evidence with 1H/13C NMR connectivity.
notes_list.conditions_and_medium: Use consistent solvent/reference assumptions; exchangeable protons should be treated cautiously.
notes_list.mechanism_steps: 1. Formula → DBE. 2. IR → functional group. 3. 13C → carbon skeleton environments. 4. 1H → fragments. 5. Assemble. 6. Verify every atom and unsaturation.
notes_list.kinetics_and_energy: DBE = (2C+2+N−H−X)/2 for ordinary neutral formulas without accounting for O/S. Spectral reasoning is constraint satisfaction rather than peak memorization.
notes_list.common_traps: Do not force a structure before checking all peaks; unexplained signals are evidence against the proposed structure.

exam_focus.level: IIT-JAM / MSc entrance / GATE concept depth
